query: SELECT o.id, o.name FROM org_memberships m JOIN organizations o ON o.id = m.org_id WHERE m.user_id = $1 AND m.preset = 'owner' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM org_memberships m2 JOIN users u ON u.id = m2.user_id WHERE m2.org_id = m.org_id AND m2.preset = 'owner' AND m2.user_id <> $1 AND u.state <> 'deleted')
